points.point: Is it still loading? Why no post after 10 minutes
points.sentence: Adding Text context does not generate a post automatically.

points.point: Whether the pasted source finished loading
points.sentence: Confirm the source finished loading and its checkbox is selected in Context.

verdict.reason: The customer pasted the article as Text context and got no post after 10 minutes, and this entry states that adding Text context does not generate a post automatically and tells them to confirm the source has finished loading and is selected.
